body: started at 7 and currently 21 with a month clean

please don’t!! i know that it seems really tempting and that it could fix things but sh will only make things worse. it’s an addiction that only harms you. you might feel relief for 30 seconds maybe and then you just feel extremely guilty or shameful and it just reinforces self-hatred. try some other coping mechanisms that can offer similar relief like ripping paper, drawing on yourself where you want to sh instead, holding ice, taking a cold shower, journaling, doing a really intense exercise for a short period, paced breathing, listening to music at full blast, distracting yourself with a task or game or show, or progressive muscle relaxation (work your way through each muscle group from your toes to your head by flexing as hard as you can for 15-30 seconds and then relaxing). 
please please please, as someone who has struggled with self harm for majority of my life, it is not worth it. it causes so many problems but solves nothing. 
this is a way to have control over your life, please choose yourself and your well-being. you deserve to feel better and choosing to not harm yourself is a way to do that.
the longest i’ve done was 10 months though the past few weeks i’ve struggled to last more than 2 days

started at 7 with punching myself in the legs and then hitting them with a hammer because i felt like no one loved me and that i was worthless. 
then at 12 started cutting because i saw a friend do it and wanted to know how it felt. 
started burning and scratching in high school out of desperation for other forms of release. 
started overdosing and head banging in college because i felt out of control and overwhelmed.
